name: PALE STATIC: Underground Neural Horror Circuit
description: A distributed underground horror experience that operates through anonymous BCI relay nodes hidden across GLMZ's the Gray Zone districts — players receive invitations encoded in junk-signal broadcasts, connect to unlicensed neural servers, and enter procedurally generated horror scenarios that deliberately blur the boundary between simulation and waking perception. PALE STATIC's signature mechanic is 'residue' — sensory echoes from the sim that persist in players' BCI for 12-72 hours after disconnection, making ordinary spaces feel haunted. No corporate authorship has ever been confirmed.
story_hooks: A player who entered PALE STATIC six months ago still experiences residue that seems to show them things that haven't happened yet — and some of those visions have come true.
A Meridian NHB investigator tracks a PALE STATIC relay node to a location that appears on no city infrastructure map.
Someone is using PALE STATIC's anonymous network to pass information that could bring down a Tier 5 family — and they need a player who's already inside the circuit to carry it.
